recommendations: For cloud engineering, choose one provider first (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud) rather than paying for overlapping entry-level credentials.
For platform/Kubernetes roles, CKA is a strong practical option; CKS is a later step and requires CKA.
Terraform Associate is a portable infrastructure-as-code credential across cloud providers.
For SRE/observability, combine cloud operations knowledge with Linux, monitoring and incident-response projects.
Do not list course completions as professional certifications; identify them accurately on the CV.
